title: Reject sensitive paths at the Windows packaging inventory
description: Independent P1.3 prerequisite. Extend the pure staged-tree inventory with one stable sensitive-path refusal before archive creation. Match only conventional secret-bearing filenames so legitimate source names such as session-token.ts remain admissible; normalize logical separators and ASCII case for hostile Windows path variants. This row must wait for explicit ownership/adoption of the current broker-packaging WIP in its two files.
definitionOfDone: Generated red-first cases cover .env and .env.*; .pem/.key/.ppk/.p12/.pfx; id_rsa/id_ed25519; and exact secret/credential/token basenames with no extension or .json/.yaml/.yml/.txt, across upper/mixed case, leading-dot, and slash/backslash path variants.
inspectStagedTree refuses every sensitive case with code PACK_SENSITIVE_FILE_PRESENT and layer PACKAGING_INVENTORY, reports path only, and never reads or logs file contents.

Nearby legitimate production paths including styles/tokens.css, session-token.ts, credential-codec.ts, and node_modules package paths remain admitted unless their basename matches the frozen sensitive roster.

The existing required-path, broker, test-artifact, VCS, dependency, bridge, import, and worktree cases remain green; focused tests run standalone with nonzero counts and removing case/separator normalization makes named generated assertions red.
taskRails: Own only tools/packaging/pack-inventory.ts and tests/integration/distribution/pack-inventory.test.ts after the current broker WIP owner explicitly marks those bytes adoptable or commits them.
Preserve the dirty WINDOWS_BROKER_STAGED_PATH and required-broker tests byte-for-byte except mechanical PackRefusal layer assertions required by the new common shape.
Sensitive admission operates on path metadata only and must not open candidate files.
Do not broaden token/credential matching to arbitrary source basenames or substrings; the frozen conventional filename roster is the authority.
